Bronze Shark Statue
Author: Tina, Poly Haven
Source: https://polyhaven.com/a/bronze_shark_statue
License: CC0 1.0 (public domain), https://polyhaven.com/license
Downloaded 2026-11-26: bronze_shark_statue_2k.fbx (2K model) and bronze_shark_statue_diff_2k.jpg (diffuse texture), both unchanged.
bronze_shark_statue_upright.asset is the FBX mesh with the file's 90-degree X rotation baked into the vertices,
so the mesh is Y-up on its own (MeshVoxelizer works on the mesh, not the FBX node). This is the mesh the Lobby uses.
